scientific_integrity: All proof and numerical statements concern exact lag-transition moments and the specified scalar surrogate. General Pearson and finite-lag OU formulas are attributed to earlier literature; no independent priority claim is made for those components.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional uncontrolled OU; exact population conditional increments rather than sampled finite datasets.
Only first-order uncentered second-increment generator and nonnegative quartic reward.
Does not extend small-lag theory to its excluded unbounded-coefficient or fourth-growth setting.
Literature overlap is assessed but not independently audited.
title: A reentrant discounted-moment singularity from finite-lag Gaussian dynamics reconstruction
